mode: BuildGpu only, Debug then Release, explicit ProductionBuildConfirmed and ExecutionAuthorized per action. No helper, program/help, solver, GenCase, test, worker or Git mutation.
unchanged: Exactly261 other source files out of265 must match the retained passed Darcy Debug/Release source inventory before and after each build. This includes JSphGpuSingle.cpp and shared JSph.cpp; the public GPU parser rejection remains outside these four candidate edits.

baseline.creation: First Debug BuildGpu action binds verified805 checkpoint, passed bounded Darcy stage, both immutable Darcy source-freeze/build receipts, exact four Git blob object IDs at805, historical raw four-source identities, unchanged261 and canonical GPU six identities. It does not read already edited targets as an old-source baseline or copy old programs/sources.
baseline.source_inventory: Both retained Darcy full265 source inventories must agree path/bytes/SHA. Compare only the261 non-target current files with those historical raw identities; freeze all current265/four new targets separately before compile.
baseline.Git_normalization: 805 Git blob object identities and historical mixed-line-ending raw build SHA identities are recorded separately; no false raw-Git-byte equality requirement. Only read-only rev-parse is used.
baseline.scope: Do not recursively revalidate an old publication manifest, mutable validation status or document graph. The immutable aggregate receipt itself is bound; it must report passed constant-k actual Pre/Corr and old default-path regressions without relaxed thresholds or general physical/publicGPU/variable-k acceptance.

build.authoritative: src/VS/DualSPHysics5Re.sln and its unchanged vcxproj identities inherited from the Darcy baseline; no alternate build system or one-file replacement of project compilation.
build.vector: Replay the actual successful corresponding Darcy r2 MSBuild program/argument vector, require owned exit0 and /t:Rebuild. Change exactly OutDir, IntDir and /bl path tokens; retain every other token and option.
build.intdir: Temp/upl_gpu_perm_r1/{Debug,Release}/int, no whitespace, fresh paths only
build.objects: Record exactly110 authoritative object identities excluding main using the retained basename closure. Helper linking/testing is not part of this driver.
build.runtime: Copy only existing hash-verified DLL/config support into the new isolated GPU output; verify original/copy and old canonical GPU identities. Never overwrite canonical executables.
build.freeze: logs/upl_gpu_perm_{Debug,Release}_r1.source.json contains current265, four_targets, unchanged_source_count261, accepted Darcy receipt and plain-string ReadAllLines API captures. This avoids the retired Get-Content ETS graph serialization issue.
build.receipts: logs/upl_gpu_perm_{Debug,Release}_r1.build.json uses status full_authoritative_GPU_Rebuild_passed_no_helper_or_program_run, source/build/runtime/input/tool hashes and original/copy bindings. Source and frozen inputs must remain unchanged through the build. No source snapshot duplication is needed.

CPU_default_Debug: Root separately owns the required default CPU Debug build; this driver neither executes nor invents a passed CPU result.
failure_policy: Preserve failed calls/logs/freeze/output directories. No overwrite, retry, rearm or source repair is performed by this driver; a new reviewed label is necessary for a new attempt.
limitations: Build-only private smooth-k GPU candidate. Compiler exit0 does not prove variable-k mathematics, same-stage acceleration/pressure/volume ownership, gradient-k timestep sufficiency, old-path exactness, CPU/GPU agreement or physical/public GPU release. Actual bounded components/trajectories remain separate gates.
